Hard-authority invariant: the independently calibrated full-envelope object constrains every hard margin in every SCAN cycle, including SUPPORTED and the undetected interval after an abrupt admitted change. A contracted online set may shape nominal cost and may add constraints, but can never remove, reduce or relax any full-envelope constraint. ADAPTING_IN_ENVELOPE drops contraction-derived performance authority while retaining full-envelope hard authority; OUTSIDE_ENVELOPE permits only WITHDRAW. Hence safety does not depend on alarm latency; online adaptation recovers ranking and reduces optional conservatism only inside the full-envelope hard-feasible set.

Select a_i=(log k_n,log d_n,log k_t,log d_t) over a short receding horizon, with positivity and rate limits. Four scan-frame diagonal gains are the concrete minimal action class; richer SPD/cross-axis impedance is a falsifying rival.

For every authorized outcome-set member constrain six-axis wrench, finite-area contact/slip/moment capacity, contact retention, actuator/joint/gain limits and a discrete interaction-energy budget including bounded reference, delay and inner-loop work; jointly penalize normal-force error, tangential path error, contact-loss/slip risk and gain variation.

Before optional optimization verify a registered withdrawal that stops tangential motion, selects dissipative rate-limited gains and unloads along the last trusted normal. Publish atomically only a fully checked scan action before deadline, otherwise WITHDRAW. RTI-SQP, fixed horizon/facets and estimator numerics are WCET-qualified realizations, not scientific necessity claims.
